items.title: Coach knows your training
items.body: Ask Coach sees your recent workouts, lifts, week plan and Fuel, so answers fit what you actually did.

items.title: Cast to your TV
items.body: Chromecast now draws the workout on the TV with smooth moves and timers. AirPlay shows the picture too.

items.title: Scan live sees your food
items.body: Point the camera at food, even in its bag: Scan live names it. Ask Monkey when it can't.

items.title: Cook together
items.body: Share your meal plan and grocery list with your partner, or send a copy.

items.title: Meal plans, one step
items.body: Budget, people and variety asked when you set it up, days filled as soon as you save.

items.title: Numbers you can trust
items.body: Every recipe shows where its numbers come from, and you can review it.

items.title: Real-life positions
items.body: The 3D guide's arms, bars and handles now line up: shrugs, dips, pull-ups and more.

items.title: Hide tabs you don't use
items.body: Fuel or Social not for you? Hide it in Settings → My tabs or from the tab's title.

items.title: Swipe to close, everywhere
items.body: Every screen closes with a swipe. Add workout keeps the tab bar and adds to the day you tapped.
